topics.title: Hall of Fame Blues and the Blue Ribbon Panel
topics.summary: Radio host Howard Rubenstein attempts to establish an award for radio, leading to awkward interactions with Emerson Radio Corporation representative Mario Andretti regarding his breath and a questionable blue ribbon selection panel. The broadcast culminates in featuring comedian Greg Lyons, but is complicated by confusion over who he actually is.

topics.title: Radio Host Banter & Absurd Questions
topics.summary: During a late-night talk show segment, hosts engage in rapid-fire and increasingly bizarre banter. Topics range from Arnold Schwarzenegger’s bathroom woes and Michael J Fox's alleged affairs to Arthur Miller’s creative process and wardrobe choices, with several tangential questions about celebrities and their personal habits.

topics.title: Uncomfortable Hollywood Interview & Celebrity Gossip
topics.summary: The radio host attempts to steer an interview about Earth Day and celebrity interviews but is repeatedly derailed by uncomfortable questions regarding Dustin Hoffman’s appearance, Robin Givens' behavior, and Howard Hessman’s past. A publicist intervenes before the conversation devolves into a lengthy discussion on hair styles.

topics.title: John, Jackie and a Boat Cover
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Howard discusses a confused interaction involving non-professional guests John and Jackie who struggle to understand basic terms like ‘boat cover.’ Judd Nelson abruptly leaves the studio before an interview with a listener discussing obesity lawsuits, leading to further commentary on listeners’ tendency to sue over minor inconveniences.

topics.title: Radio Host’s Absurdity
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, the host engages in bizarre and self-contradictory conversations, including an outlandish request for bone marrow from Lithuanians while simultaneously dismissing suggestions and complaining about advertising copy. He also has a strange encounter with Dustin Hoffman involving Venetian blinds and a desire to buy a surround sound system.

topics.title: Arthur's Award & GLAAD Criticism
topics.summary: During a radio segment, Arthur repeatedly demands yelling at him due to disagreements about advertising and LGBTQ+ issues, eventually receiving an award from GLAAD despite criticism. The hosts discuss news articles including those related to Andrew Dice Clay, Liz Smith, and Jamie Lee Curtis, with frequent tangents on personal opinions and media coverage.
